description:
Presidential Secretariat -Resignation of Hon. Governors have resigned from their office with effect from September 22, 2024.
(Six Governors)
reasoning: This gazette exclusively lists the resignations of six named individuals from their positions as Provincial Governors. It provides only the names and their basic titles (e.g., "Hon. Governor of the Central Province") without describing any of their duties, responsibilities, or portfolio details. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
